metadata.title: Engineering Access Control

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing privileged access to device engineering, maintenance, and diagnostic interfaces.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Engineering consoles, maintenance ports, diagnostic interfaces, remote access channels, and device management tooling.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining controlled access to device engineering interfaces independent of safety or authorization.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines engineering access events as high‑sensitivity control data requiring attribution and audit.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines baseline expectations for controlling privileged access to device functions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance for protecting device management and maintenance interfaces.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that privileged access must be explicitly mediated and continuously evaluated.

metadata.remarks: Engineering Access Control defines how privileged access to device engineering and maintenance interfaces is controlled and observed. This pattern does not authorize specific actions, assert safety, or approve changes.

components.title: Privileged Interface Identification
components.description: Identification and classification of device interfaces that allow engineering, maintenance, or diagnostic interaction.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Privileged device interfaces are explicitly identified and managed.

components.title: Engineering Access Authentication
components.description: Authentication of identities attempting to access privileged device interfaces.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Engineering access requires strong, attributable authentication.

components.title: Engineering Session Control
components.description: Control of session initiation, duration, and termination for privileged access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Privileged access sessions are bounded and controllable.

components.title: Engineering Access Observability
components.description: Logging and monitoring of engineering access activity for audit and analysis.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Engineering access events are audited and reviewable.

components.title: Engineering Access Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what having engineering access does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Engineering access does not imply permission to change, operate, or override safety or policy controls.
